upstream.source: src/analysis/mod.rs (baseline directory lookup, comparison and promotion)

behaviors: Automatic comparison and promotion after successful direct Cargo measurement and requested artifact output
First-run, compared and incompatible states per case; filtered runs do not erase history of unselected cases
Immutable generated paths, SHA-256 validation and atomic final publication marker; incomplete entries ignored, corrupt committed entries fail visibly
Concurrent writers keep distinct complete entries and compare snapshots of committed history
Smoke/profile/list/dry-run and no-history modes do not publish entries
Raw original runs retained; realized sample counts and quick stop reasons ignored only in the comparison projection
JSON and text previous-run output, custom history root and explicit opt-out
limits: Namespaces include suite and executable filename; a changed Cargo binary identity can start a separate history
Comparison retains strict environment, metric and lifecycle/configuration compatibility
One process per direct invocation gives descriptive changes and normally an inconclusive inferential verdict; hypothesis-test extensions remain in significance requirement
Named baseline save/load/retain/discard policies remain in baseline requirement
